text:
Alex R: Heads-up — planning to ship a compact-attributes pruning for telemetry ingest this Friday 03:00 PT. Need to align on console read-side guardrails and rollback signals.
Mira S: which attrs are we pruning? list pls so dashboard owners can check queries. :eyes:
Alex R: short list: `user_agent_v2`, `route_label_meta`, `deprecated_quota_tag`. They're low-cardinality or duplicated fields we want to drop to save index cost.
Sam K: big caveat — a few dashboards reference `route_label_meta` joins. If dropped reads will return NULL and some materialized views will break. We need runtime adapters or dual-write.
Julia P: +1 on dual-write. Suggest: 2-week shadow write of compact shape to new tables, console query layer tries compact then falls back to legacy. Feature-flag the fallback.
Tyler N: shadow write cost estimate ~2.3 TB/day for peak ingest; ops ok with it for 2 weeks? also backfill plan if we decide to cutover earlier.
Alex R: Ops ok with burst. Rollout plan draft: (1) start shadow dual writes, (2) enable read-fallback in console, (3) canary console team A for 6 hours, monitor missing-field-rate and query-error-rate, (4) flip read to compact, keep fallback for 48h, (5) disable legacy write after 2w.
Mira S: what are the exact metrics/alerts? need to surface to dashboard owners and oncall.
Alex R: alert if missing-field-rate > 0.5% of queries or query-error-rate increases > 0.2% over baseline for 15m. Also create a synthetic query suite to run during canary.
Sam K: can we add a quick compatibility adapter in console: `if (!has(field)) try_legacy_join()` ? That avoids null-blobs and is cheap.
Julia P: yep — implement as a short-circuit in the materializer. We'll need a feature flag so we can toggle fallbacks per-route.
Tyler N: ops: scheduling deploy window Friday 03:00 PT -> deploy-bot scheduled it. tag: `ingest/compact-ship`.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: `ingest/compact-ship` will run Fri 03:00 PT. Notify #eng-oncall 30m prior.
Mira S: owners notified, I'll post a short note to dashboard-owners and include the list of queries to grep for deprecated fields.
Alex R: I'll author the migration playbook and add the rollback steps: (A) flip read-fallback on, (B) re-enable legacy write if needed, (C) run backfill adapter to rehydrate legacy field. Keep us synced in this thread.
Sam K: quick snippet for fallback logic to prototype:```js
const v = row.compact?.route_label_meta;
if (!v) {
  return legacyJoin(row.id);
}
return v;
```
Julia P: perfect. I'll add the feature flag gating and unit tests.
Tyler N: tagging infra to increase retention for shadow tables for 14 days. cost center: PLATFORM-MIGRATIONS.
Alex R: thanks everyone. final ask: if you see any dashboard that would break silently, ping me here — we'll add it to the canary group. :thumbsup:
